findings.title: §14 unpriceable law does not cover the death_open branch — demonstrated residual ZeroDivisionError crash path and spurious -1.0 mark into the BC-7 invariance rerun
findings.detail: The §14 branch guards only the priced (natural/force-flat) path. The death_open branch (i_amended_legs.py L78, byte-identical to frozen i_engine.py L621) computes op[n-1]/op[entry_i]-1 before any §14 check. (a) A zero adjusted open at a death_open leg's entry raises ZeroDivisionError in the AMENDED engine too (probe case E) — the scored run would TECHABORT again mid-cell with that cell's budget slot already consumed (used incremented at cell START, e_stream_run.py L374); this is fail-closed (no invalid result) but defeats the amendment's declared purpose on one of the two gross-arithmetic sites §14 itself names. (b) A zero at the death-session open yields a death_open leg with gross=-1.0 (probe case F) which spills to cens and enters the included-at-marks variant, contrary to §14's 'no marks exist for it'. §14's window definition ('under its own fold force-flat / death branches') plainly includes death-branch touches; a narrower reading (eff_exit only exists on the priced path; death legs already BC-7 censored) is defensible but renders the law's 'death branches' words surplusage — the choice between readings is the OWNER's, not the implementer's.
findings.required_action: Owner adjudication BEFORE any fresh GO: either (i) extend the amendment so the unpriceable check also covers the death_open gross site (classify death-branch legs whose touch set contains a non-positive open as unpriceable_adj_price — still fail-closed, still 'the one law'), then fresh-context A7 re-audit; or (ii) explicitly narrow the frozen §14 text (death legs remain death_open; residual crash risk accepted and disclosed as a possible third TECHABORT with one budget slot consumed). Fresh exact owner GO (P-8) required after either path. Registered GO precondition 'fresh-context A7 zero-unresolved-HIGH/CRITICAL' (e_stream_run.py docstring) is currently NOT met.

findings.title: §14 unpriceable count will NOT appear in the persisted cell verdict's censored-leg disclosure
findings.detail: §14 requires the new kind 'counted separately in the cell verdict's censored-leg disclosure' and 'Exact affected-leg counts are emitted by the run itself'. The mirror computes the disclosure (death_censoring_accounting: censored_legs + kinds, dynamic) and the counts dict carries censored_unpriceable_adj_price, but _gate_summary — frozen-inherited, byte-identical in i/adjudicate.py — strips that gate from the persisted stage_a.gates, and adjudicate_candidate_stream/e_stream_run p4 persist neither counts nor censored_kinds in cell_verdict.json. The count remains recoverable only from the per-book checkpoint npz (counts_json / censored_kinds_json of <book>__accum_genN.npz), not from the verdict artifact the law names. Frozen-inherited behavior (both paths identical), no numeric effect; one-line fix (persist sa['gates']['death_censoring_accounting'] or BookStats.counts/censored_kinds into rep).
findings.required_action: Remediate pre-GO (preferred, trivial) or obtain owner waiver of the disclosure-location mismatch.
